early_blight.advice: Reduce nitrogen by 20% to prevent excessive leafy growth which encourages early blight lesion spread. Avoid overwatering as prolonged leaf wetness promotes disease development.

late_blight.advice: Reduce nitrogen by 30% and delay irrigation significantly. Late blight thrives in wet, humid conditions; maintaining dry foliage is critical.

leaf_curl.advice: Increase nitrogen by 20% and maintain consistent moisture. Leaf curl virus stresses the plant, requiring slightly higher nutrient support and prevention of drought stress.
